why_not_executable: No official PixelLab operation or input schema was discovered in this session; only the local PIXL runtime is configured. This brief is the reviewed intent to translate into provider arguments once the official connection is available.
subject: Scout character, side view, representative sample for a two-member family (scout, medic)

owner_requirements.outline: continuous dark outline as in reference.png

exact_palette.reason: The three opaque colours measured in reference.png. Keeping the sample to these colours matches the flat, unshaded reference and avoids intermediate edge colours; the owner named the palette by role, so exclusivity is open until the sample is reviewed.

facing.reason: A shared facing direction is needed for family continuity in a side-view game; right-facing is the common default for side-scrollers. The medic should match.

ground_line.value: feet on the same bottom row as the reference figure (zero-based row 28, three transparent rows below)
ground_line.reason: Keeps the scout and medic standing on one shared ground line so they align when placed side by side.

identity_landmarks.value: peaked cap or hood brim; a shoulder-strap satchel across the torso; one cream eye block in the reference's manner
identity_landmarks.reason: Distinguishes a scout from the medic using silhouette rather than colour, because the family palette is small.

shading.value: flat fill, no shading, no anti-aliasing
shading.status: proposal, follows from the exact-palette proposal
shading.reason: reference.png is flat with three colours; intermediate colours would break the proposed palette.

reference_roles.preserve: continuous dark outline, flat teal fill, cream accents, blocky cluster scale; the figure itself is not the scout's silhouette
the teal and cream colour pair only; its missing outline is not the chosen treatment

prompt_draft: A small scout character in side view facing right, flat pixel art on a 32 by 32 transparent canvas. Body filled with teal (#56B5BC), cream (#F4DDA2) accents for the eye, cap badge and satchel buckle, every edge bounded by a continuous dark outline (#25354A). Peaked cap with a short brim, a satchel on a strap across the torso, light slim build, feet planted on a shared ground line. Blocky simple shapes with no shading, no gradients and no anti-aliasing, matching the supplied style reference. Only the three listed colours plus full transparency.
negative_notes: No background, no drop shadow, no additional colours or shades, no three-quarter or front view, no outline gaps.

candidate_operations_advisory.basis: Cached capability inventory in pixl-kit/resources/knowledge/pixellab-capabilities.json retrieved 2026-09-11; not live discovery. Verify the actual connected tool and its schema before preparing a request.

options.why: Single freeform sprite with width, height, no_background, view=side, direction=east, outline and shading controls; accepts a style/init image per its live schema. Fits a 32 by 32 single-frame sample.
Supports a labelled style image and style_copy (palette, outline, detail, shading) for stronger reference conditioning; check its minimum canvas and output size against 32 by 32.
Only if the game later needs directional turnarounds or animation; it returns 4 or 8 directions, which is more than this single side-view sample needs.

candidate_operations_advisory.image_transport: Bind reference.png through the tool's supported image input (upload handle, URL or base64 as declared by the live schema); a filename in the prompt does not transmit the image.
